description: Source code for the Toolbar React component in a Kanban board project. It provides UI controls for managing columns, CSV import/export, fullscreen toggle, and related actions within the front-end module.

methods.name: downloadExcelTemplate()
methods.description: Generates and downloads an Excel template for bulk card entry with predefined columns.

methods.name: Toolbar({ onToggleFullscreen, isFullscreen, crOnly, onToggleCrOnly, canEdit = true })
methods.description: Main React functional component providing the toolbar UI with various controls for the Kanban board.

methods.name: handleAddColumn
methods.description: Opens modal to add a new column.

methods.name: handleAddColumnSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of new column addition, updating state and UI.

methods.name: handleExcelUpload
methods.description: Processes uploaded Excel files, parses content, and triggers bulk upload modal.

methods.name: handleConfirmBulkUpload
methods.description: Confirms requested bulk upload, converts rows to card objects, and inserts them into the database.

methods.name: handleExportCardsCsv
methods.description: Exports current cards to a CSV file and triggers download.

methods.name: handleCsvFileSelected
methods.description: Reads and previews CSV file for re-import/sync functionality.

methods.name: handleConfirmCsvSync
methods.description: Performs CSV sync (upsert) and manages undo snapshot state.

methods.name: handleUndoCsvSync
methods.description: Undoes the last CSV sync, restoring previous DB state.

ctags.name: Toolbar
ctags.pattern: /^function Toolbar({ onToggleFullscreen, isFullscreen, crOnly, onToggleCrOnly, canEdit = true }) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ onToggleFullscreen, isFullscreen, crOnly, onToggleCrOnly, canEdit = true })
